attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Pharmacy (Office of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by ACPE, AMA Category 1, the Board or a Board-designated entity

topics.who: Pharmacists with a DEA number or pending DEA application: controlled substance abuse/diversion, safe use, storage and disposal, Vermont Prescription Monitoring System, addiction risk, alternatives to opioids for pain, tapering, or opioid prescribing law

rules.notes: CE each biennial period as a condition of renewal. Pharmacists doing sterile or hazardous drug compounding (or USP <797>/<800> Designated Persons) need at least 3 hours on that subject (no topic code). Out-of-state telepharmacists follow the home jurisdiction's CE.
rules.legal_basis: Administrative Rules for the Vermont Board of Pharmacy, Rule 6-1 (eff. Feb 1, 2026)
